name: autonomic
description: Autopilot as a Claude Code mod. In autopilot (AUTONOMIC_MODE=autopilot per spawn, or /autopilot on) a global policy joins the system prompt; at each turn end, each AskUserQuestion and each permission ask a cached fork judges the stop against the policy and the session's scope; covered asks and stalls continue, every decision is appended to a ledger, and the closed pain list reaches you by toast, band and an optional bell. Fails toward manual. Requires Claude Code 2.1.289 or later.

policyPath.title: Policy file
policyPath.description: The autopilot standing orders. Written with the default on first start; edit it freely.

bell.title: Bell command
bell.description: A shell command run on each pain signal, with AUTONOMIC_MESSAGE set to one line, for example: curl -d "$AUTONOMIC_MESSAGE" ntfy.sh/<topic>. AUTONOMIC_BELL on a spawn overrides it. Unset: toast and band only.

loopMax.title: Pushes in a row with no change
loopMax.description: After this many covered or stalled turn ends with no change made, the next turn end is a pain signal.

tailChars.title: Reply tail for the turn-end check (characters)
tailChars.description: How much of the last reply the turn-end fork quotes.

yieldAtPercent.title: Context fill where molt owns the turn end (%)
yieldAtPercent.description: Used only when molt publishes no stage file (molt absent or older than 0.2.1): at or above this fill autonomic lets every turn end stand.

neverApprove.title: Never-approve rules
neverApprove.description: In autopilot, a command matching one of these always reaches you, even under bypass permissions. Remove a name to let the fork judge it. Known: force-push default-branch-push branch-delete rm-outside no-verify unreadable (unreadable matches nothing since 0.2.0). Empty: none.
neverApprove.default: force-push default-branch-push branch-delete rm-outside no-verify unreadable
